summary.oneLiner: Devson Catalyst Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified indigenous manufacturer of catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls used as key materials in various industrial processes.
summary.business: Devson Catalyst Limited is an indigenous manufacturer of catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls that are used to improve process efficiency and facilitate removal of impurities from gases and liquids across various industrial applications. Its products are supplied to customers operating in industries such as oil and gas refineries, petrochemicals, steel, fertilizers and other industrial processing sectors, in both domestic and international markets. The Company operates a single manufacturing facility in Gujarat with a total installed capacity of approximately 6,205.00 MT per annum.

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Key raw materials are procured from a limited number of suppliers through purchase orders without long-term supply arrangements (top-1 / top-5 / top-10 suppliers were ~15-23% / ~66-69% / ~82-87% of raw-material cost). Manufacturing is carried out at a single Gujarat facility. No specific backward/forward integration is disclosed.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: The Company proposes to utilise net proceeds of the Offer towards funding the capital expenditure requirements for setting up a new manufacturing unit, in addition to funding working capital requirements and general corporate purposes.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- Indigenous manufacturer of Catalysts, Adsorbents and Ceramic balls in India
- Track record of profitability and consistent financial performance in an industry with significant entry barriers
- Strategically located Manufacturing Facilities with capabilities to handle multiple products lines
- Well-positioned in an industry with several entry barriers
- Strong customer base & relationship with global footprint
- Experienced management team and qualified personnel with significant industry experience

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Claims against the company not acknowledged as debts of Rs. 32.46 Lakhs (GST demand, appeal filed May 13, 2024, pending at SGST Appellate Authority) pertaining to ITC availment for FY 2017-18
- Company has taken loans from Promoters and Promoter-group HUFs (e.g. borrowing balances of Rs. 81.10 Lakhs and Rs. 29.20 Lakhs as at 31-Mar-25) creating dependence on related-party funding
- All manufacturing operations are carried out at one facility in Wadhwan City, Surendranagar, Gujarat, concentrating operational risk at a single location

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Company intends to utilise net proceeds of the Offer towards funding the capital expenditure requirements for setting up a new manufacturing unit.**
- **Company intends to utilise net proceeds of the Offer towards funding the working capital requirements of the Company.**
- **Company will list its Equity Shares on the SME Platform of BSE (BSE SME) to enhance its corporate image, brand visibility, provide liquidity to existing shareholders and create a public trading market.**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Setting up of a new manufacturing unit funded through the capital expenditure component of the Offer proceeds
- Funding the working capital requirements of the Company
- Listing of Equity Shares on the SME Platform of BSE (BSE SME) to enhance corporate image, brand visibility and provide liquidity
